<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">(e) (1) Pre-Approval Policies. The policy of the Registrant&#146;s Audit Committee is to consider and, if appropriate, approve before the principal accountant is engaged for such services, all specific audit and non-audit services provided to: the Registrant, other registered investment companies in the Vanguard complex, The Vanguard Group, Inc., and entities controlled by The Vanguard Group, Inc. that provide ongoing services to the Registrant. In making a determination, the Audit Committee considers whether the services are consistent with maintaining the principal accountant&#146;s independence.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">In the event of a contingency situation in which the principal accountant is needed to provide services in between scheduled Audit Committee meetings, the Chairman of the Audit Committee would be called on to consider and, if appropriate, pre-approve audit or permitted non-audit services in an amount sufficient to complete services through the next Audit Committee meeting, and to determine if such services would be consistent with maintaining the accountant&#146;s independence. At the next scheduled Audit Committee meeting, services and fees would be presented to the Audit Committee for formal consideration, and, if appropriate, approval by the entire Audit Committee. The Audit Committee would again consider whether such services and fees are consistent with maintaining the principal accountant&#146;s independence.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The Registrant&#146;s Audit Committee is informed at least annually of all audit and non-audit services provided by the principal accountant to the Vanguard complex, whether such services are provided to: the Registrant, other registered investment companies in the Vanguard complex, The Vanguard Group, Inc., or other entities controlled by The Vanguard Group, Inc. that provide ongoing services to the Registrant.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">(2) No percentage of the principal accountant&#146;s fees or services were approved pursuant to the waiver provision of paragraph (c)(7)(i)(C) of Rule 2-01 of Regulation S-X.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">(f) For the most recent fiscal year, over 50% of the hours worked under the principal accountant&#146;s engagement were </FONT><U><FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">not </FONT></U><FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">performed by persons other than full-time, permanent employees of the principal accountant.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">(g) Aggregate Non-Audit Fees.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2014: &#36;515,032</FONT><BR>
<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2013: &#36;242,000</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Includes fees billed for non-audit services provided to the Registrant, other registered investment companies in the Vanguard complex, The Vanguard Group, Inc., and Vanguard Marketing Corporation.</FONT></P>
<P style="text-align: left;">
<FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">(h) For the most recent fiscal year, the Audit Committee has determined that the provision of all non-audit services was consistent with maintaining the principal accountant&#146;s independence.</FONT></P>

<B><FONT size=2 face="Arial-BoldMT,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Item 5</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face="Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">: Audit Committee of Listed Registrants.</FONT></P>

<p align=right style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-align:right;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;text-transform:uppercase;">&#160;&#160;&#160; </font></b></p>

<p align=right style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-align:right;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;text-transform:uppercase;">&nbsp;</font></b></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-align:center;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;text-transform:uppercase;">the
vanguard FUNDS&#8217;</font></b></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-align:center;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;text-transform:uppercase;">CODE OF
Ethics</font></b></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-align:center;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;text-transform:uppercase;">fOR</font></b></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-align:center;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;text-transform:uppercase;">SENIOR
executive and FINANCIAL OFFICERS</font></b></p>

<h1 style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:0in;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">I.</font></b><b><font face="times new roman" style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font></b><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">Introduction</font></b></h1>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#160;The Board of
Trustees of each registered investment company that is managed, sponsored, and
distributed by The Vanguard Group, Inc. (&#8220;VGI&#8221;) (each a &#8220;Vanguard Fund&#8221; and
collectively the &#8220;Vanguard Funds&#8221;) has adopted this code of ethics (the &#8220;Code&#8221;)
as required by Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act.&#160; The Code applies to the
individuals in positions listed on Exhibit A (the &#8220;Covered Officers&#8221;).&#160; All
Covered Officers, along with employees of The Vanguard Group, Inc., are subject
to separate and distinct obligations from this Code under a Code of Ethics
adopted pursuant to Rule 17j-1 under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (&#8220;17j-1
Code of Ethics&#8221;), policies to prevent the misuse of non-public information, and
other internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be in effect from
time to time.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">This Code is designed to
promote:</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face=symbol lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#183;</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Honest and ethical conduct, including the ethical handling of
conflicts of interest;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face=symbol lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#183;</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Full, fair, accurate, timely, and understandable disclosure in
reports and documents that a Vanguard Fund files with, or submits to, the U.S.
Securities and Exchange Commission, or in other public communications made by
the Vanguard Funds or VGI; </font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face=symbol lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#183;</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Compliance with applicable laws, governmental rules, and
regulations; </font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face=symbol lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#183;</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Prompt internal reporting to those identified in the Code of
violations of the Code; and</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face=symbol lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#183;</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Accountability for adherence to the Code.</font></p>

<h1 style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-.5in;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">II.</font></b><b><font face="times new roman" style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font></b><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">Actual or Apparent Conflicts of Interest</font></b></h1>

<h1 style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-weight:normal;">A.&#160; Covered Officers should
conduct all activities in accordance with the following principles:</font></h1>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">1.&#160;&#160; </font><u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">Shareholders&#8217; interests come first</font></u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">. In
the course of fulfilling their duties and responsibilities to Vanguard Fund
shareholders, Covered Officers must at all times place the interests of
Vanguard Fund shareholders first.&#160; In particular, Covered Officers must avoid
serving their own personal interests ahead of the interests of Vanguard Fund
shareholders.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">2.&#160;&#160; </font><u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">Conflicts of interest must be avoided</font></u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">.&#160;
Covered Officers must avoid any situation involving an actual or potential
conflict of interest or possible impropriety with respect to their duties and
responsibilities to Vanguard Fund shareholders.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align=center style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:193.5pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-157.5pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:10.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">III.14b.1
</font></p>
<a name="_bclFooter1"></a><DIV>


<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>


</DIV>
</DIV><HR noshade align="center" width="100%" size=2><DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always">&nbsp;</div><a name="page_2"></a><a name="_bclPageBorder2"></a><DIV STYLE="WIDTH: 100%; PADDING-RIGHT: 0%; PADDING-LEFT: 0%">

<a name="_bclHeader2"></a><DIV>


<div style="">

<div align=left><table cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 border=0>
 <tr>
  <td align=left valign=top style="padding-bottom:0in;padding-left:0in;padding-right:0in;padding-top:0in;">
  <p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font style=""><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-weight:normal;">&nbsp;</font></font></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
</table></div>

</div>

<p align=right style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:right;"><font style=""><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;font-weight:normal;">&nbsp;</font></font></p>


</DIV>


<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">3.&#160;&#160; </font><u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">Compromising situations must be avoided</font></u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">.&#160;
Covered Officers must not take advantage of their position of trust and
responsibility.&#160; Covered Officers must avoid any situation that might
compromise or call into question their exercise of full independent judgment in
the best interests of Vanguard Fund shareholders.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">All
activities of Covered Officers should be guided by and adhere to these
fiduciary standards regardless of whether the activity is specifically
described in this Code.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-indent:.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">B.&#160; Restricted
Activities</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">1.&#160;&#160; </font><u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">Prohibition on secondary employment</font></u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">.&#160;
Covered Officers are prohibited from accepting or serving in any form of
secondary employment.&#160; Secondary employment that does not create a potential
conflict of interest may be approved by the General Counsel of VGI.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">2.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font><u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">Prohibition on service as
director or public official</font></u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">.&#160;
Unless approved by the General Counsel of VGI, </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Covered Officers are
prohibited from serving on the board of directors of any publicly traded
company or in an official capacity for any federal, state, or local government
(or governmental agency or instrumentality).</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">3.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;letter-spacing:-.1pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font><u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Prohibition on misuse of Vanguard time or property</font></u><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">.&#160;
Covered Officers are prohibited from making use of time, equipment, services,
personnel or property of any Vanguard entity for any purposes other than the
performance of their duties and responsibilities in connection with the
Vanguard Funds or other Vanguard-related entities.</font></p>

<h1 style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:0in;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">III.</font></b><b><font face="times new roman" style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font></b><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">Disclosure and Compliance</font></b></h1>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">A.&#160; Each
Covered Officer should be familiar with the disclosure requirements generally
applicable to the Vanguard Funds.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">B.&#160; Each
Covered Officer should not knowingly misrepresent, or cause others to
misrepresent, facts about the Vanguard Funds to others, including to the
Vanguard Funds&#8217; directors and auditors, or to government regulators and
self-regulatory organizations.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">C.&#160; Each
Covered Officer should, to the extent appropriate within the Covered Officer&#8217;s
area of responsibility, consult with other officers and employees of VGI and
advisers to a Vanguard Fund with the goal of promoting full, fair, accurate,
timely and understandable disclosure in the reports and documents the fund
files with, or submits to, the SEC and in other public communications made by a
Vanguard Fund.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">D.&#160; It
is the responsibility of each Covered Officer to promote compliance with the
standards and restrictions imposed by applicable laws, rules, regulations, and
the 17j-1 Code of Ethics.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<h1 style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:0in;">&nbsp;</h1>
<a name="_bclFooter2"></a><DIV>


<p align=center style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:center;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;">III.14b.</font><font style="display:none;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;"></font></font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;">2</font><font style="display:none;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;"></font></font></p>

<p align=center style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:center;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align=right style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:right;"><font style=""><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;font-weight:normal;">&nbsp;</font></font></p>


</DIV>
<h1 style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:0in;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">IV.</font></b><b><font face="times new roman" style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</font></b><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">Reporting and Accountability</font></b></h1>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">A.&#160; Each
Covered Officer must:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">1.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Upon
adoption or amendment of the Code (or thereafter as applicable, upon becoming a
Covered Officer), affirm in writing that he or she has received, read, and
understands the Code; </font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">2.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Affirm
at least annually in writing that he or she has complied with the requirements of
the Code;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">3.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Not
retaliate against any other Covered Officer or any employee of VGI for reports
of potential violations of the Code that are made in good faith; and</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">4.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Notify
the General Counsel of VGI promptly if the Covered Officer knows of any
violations of this Code.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:6.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">B.&#160; The Vanguard Funds will use the following procedures in investigating
and enforcing this Code:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<h3 style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:13.0pt;font-weight:normal;">1.</font><font face="times new roman" style="font-size:7.0pt;font-weight:normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-weight:normal;">The
General Counsel of VGI is responsible for applying this Code to specific
situations and has the authority to interpret this Code in any particular
situation.&#160; The General Counsel will report on an as-needed basis to the Board
of Trustees regarding activities subject to the Code.&#160; </font></h3>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">2.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">The
General Counsel will take all appropriate action to investigate any potential
violations of the Code that are reported to him or her.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">3.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">If,
after investigation, the General Counsel believes that no material violation of
the Code has occurred, the General Counsel is not required to take any further
action.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">4.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Any
matter that the General Counsel believes is a material violation of the Code
will be reported to the Chief Compliance Officer and the Board of Trustees of
the Vanguard Funds.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">5.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">If
the Board of Trustees of the Vanguard Funds concurs that a material violation
of the Code has occurred, the Board will consider appropriate action.&#160; Appropriate
action may include reassignment, suspension, or dismissal of the applicable
Covered Officer(s), or any other sanctions the Board deems appropriate.&#160; Appropriate
action may also include review of, and appropriate modifications to, applicable
policies and procedures.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.5in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:.0001pt;margin-left:.75in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:13.0pt;">6.</font><font face="times new roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:7.0pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Any
changes to or waiver of this Code will, to the extent required, be disclosed as
provided by SEC rules.</font></p>




<h1 style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:0in;">&nbsp;</h1>
<a name="_bclFooter3"></a><DIV>


<p align=center style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:center;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;">III.14b.</font><font style="display:none;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;"></font></font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;">3</font><font style="display:none;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;"></font></font></p>

<p align=center style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:center;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=X-NONE style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<h1 style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:0in;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">Other Policies and Procedures</font></b></h1>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">This Code shall
be the sole code of conduct adopted by the Vanguard Funds for purposes of
Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and the rules and forms applicable to
registered investment companies thereunder. Insofar as other policies or
procedures of the Vanguard Funds, VGI, or other service providers govern or
purport to govern the behavior or activities of the Covered Officers, they are
superseded by this Code to the extent that they overlap or conflict with the
provisions of this Code. </font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font face=timesnewroman lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">VGI&#8217;s and the Vanguard</font><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">
Funds&#8217; 17j-1 Code of Ethics, policies to prevent the misuse of non-public
information, and other internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be
in effect from time to time </font><font face=timesnewroman lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">are
separate requirements applying to the Covered Officers and others, and are not
part of this Code.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;text-indent:0in;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">VI.&#160; &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; Amendments</font></b></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; This Code may not be
materially amended except by the approval of a majority vote of the independent
trustees of the Vanguard Funds&#8217; Board of Trustees.&#160; Non-material, technical,
and administrative revisions of the Code do not have to be approved by the
Board of Trustees.&#160;&#160; Amendments must be in writing and communicated promptly to
the Covered Officers, who shall affirm receipt of the amended Code in accordance
with Section IV. A. 1.&#160; </font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;text-indent:0in;"><b><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">VII.&#160; &#160;&#160; Confidentiality</font></b></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; All reports and
records prepared or maintained pursuant to this Code shall be considered
confidential and shall be maintained and protected accordingly.&#160; Except as
otherwise required by law or this Code, such matters shall not be disclosed to
anyone other than </font><font color=black face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">the Vanguard Funds&#8217; Board of
Trustees, VGI&#8217;s General Counsel and the Chief Compliance Officer of VGI and the
Vanguard Funds.</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;margin-left:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-top:12.0pt;text-indent:0in;"><font face="Times New Roman" lang=EN-US style="font-size:12.0pt;">Last Reviewed: March 20, 2014</font></p>
